release_package_staging.integrity: SHA-256 against official GitHub Release asset digest

execution.confirmation: explicit browser confirmation after official release SHA-256 verification
execution.archive_safety: reject absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks and special files; enforce file-count and expanded-size limits

certificate_manager.authentication: HTTPS + local session token + Origin/Host validation

bitcoin_identity.private_key_transmission: sent only over the authenticated HTTPS loopback connection to the local Lobby process; never sent to a remote service or written to disk
bitcoin_identity.proof: single-use ECDSA challenge verified against compressed secp256k1 public key and derived P2WPKH address
bitcoin_identity.identity_assurance: declared name plus proof of control of the supplied Bitcoin key; not civil-identity verification
bitcoin_identity.first_install_gate: server-side first-install execution is blocked unless a non-expired verified Bitcoin proof is staged
bitcoin_identity.local_key_handling: Accepted only by the HTTPS loopback API after session token and Host/Origin checks; used transiently in memory, omitted from the pending identity JSON, and request payload is cleared on success or failure. Memory zeroization is best-effort and cannot be guaranteed.
bitcoin_identity.transport: HTTPS loopback only; local session token and Host/Origin validation required
bitcoin_identity.browser_signing_model: The browser submits the raw HEX scalar only to the authenticated HTTPS loopback API; the local Lobby derives the address and signs the one-time challenge.
bitcoin_identity.node_association: After successful first installation, the Lobby loads and validates the installed Ed25519 NODE ID, signs a one-time local association challenge, verifies the signature, and links the existing entity_id to that node in ~/.node-core/identity/entity-registry.json. The registry relationship remains declared; node-key possession is recorded as cryptographically verified.
